text:
Marta: Heads-up: launch week checklist for the post + benchmark longread + webinar landing. Need concrete SEO ops: sitemap entries, JSON-LD for article+event, 8 redirects from old campaign pages, and HubSpot hidden UTMs. Can we split tasks?
Diego: I can do redirects and canonical rules. Please drop the 8 legacy slugs in this thread. I'll convert to Netlify/_redirects and open a PR.
Claire: I'll own JSON-LD (Article for benchmark + Event for webinar) and the internal linking map (where to anchor CTAs). Plan to include mainEntityOfPage, author object, datePublished, and virtual location for the event.
Marta: UTM standardization: utm_source=(organic|paid), utm_medium=(cta|email|social), utm_campaign=launch_q3_2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=launch_q3_2026, lead_channel=organic. Leads should land in HS list "Launch_Q3_2026" and Zapier -> SFDC queue Marketing_Webinar for MQLs.
Diego: Note for devs: strip utm_* from rel=canonical and pre-render OG tags for the webinar page. Also set rel=prev/next for paginated benchmark sections and only expose page=1 in sitemap.
Claire: Quick JSON-LD snippet I'll use for the webinar (will fill hosts/speakers): <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Launch: Benchmark & Demo","startDate":"2026-08-12T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"}}</script>
Marta: Internal linking: from benchmark -> features, quickstart tutorial, speakers bios, and webinar CTA at top + 2x mid-article. Use varied anchor text: "benchmark results", "performance breakdown", "register for webinar".
DevBot: Reminder: set <link rel="canonical"> on canonical page, add noindex to thin tag/category archives.
Diego: I'll wait for the slug list. Once I have it I'll open the redirect PR and ping @marketing-team for final QA.
Marta: Owners recap: Claire = JSON-LD + link map (EOD Wed); Diego = redirects + canonical PR; I'll verify HubSpot mapping with CS. Reply with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge.
Claire: \u2705 on JSON-LD and anchor map.
Diego: \u2705 will prepare redirects once slugs land here.
Marta: Thanks team  will schedule a 10m prelaunch QA the day before. :rocket:
